title: mono: use resolved targets for method reachability
body:
Fixes #258.

## Problem

Monomorphization handled an instance call such as `LoadError.message()` by enqueueing every method with the bare name `message`. That made unrelated stdlib methods reachable; the reporter reproduction then lowered `IoError_message` in the wrong program context and failed with `UnresolvedVariable("msg")`.

## Change

Pass the type checker TypedProgram into production monomorphization and use its CALL6 `Callee::Method` target as the exact reachable method. Keep the existing conservative bare-name fallback for standalone or unresolved cases that do not have a typed dispatch target.

## Verification

- Before: the release CLI failed on the issue reproduction with `MIR lowering 'IoError_message': UnresolvedVariable("msg")`.
- After: the same native run exits successfully and prints `1 2 3`, `none`, and `10 20 30`.
- `cargo test -p rask-mono` — 49 passed
- `cargo test -p rask-compiler` — 19 passed
- `cargo build --release -p rask-cli`
- `git diff --check`

## Risk

The production path now consumes the dispatch result already established by the type checker. The conservative fallback remains for callers without TypedProgram data.

## Assistance disclosure

OpenAI Codex helped trace the failure, implement the patch, and run the checks. I reviewed the scoped diff and evidence before submission.
